1.1.1.judge: Do text descriptions of meaningful images say what the image shows or does; are decorative images hidden?
1.1.1.notTestedReason: Whether image descriptions match the images needs a person who knows the content.

1.2.1.judge: Is there a transcript or equivalent for audio-only and video-only media?
1.2.1.notTestedReason: Whether audio and silent videos have an equivalent needs someone to play them.

1.2.2.judge: Do recorded videos with sound offer captions (track, player captions or burned-in)?
1.2.2.notTestedReason: Caption presence and accuracy need a person to watch the videos.

1.2.3.judge: Is there audio description or a full text alternative for recorded video?
1.2.3.notTestedReason: Whether videos describe what they show needs a person to watch them.

1.2.4.judge: Do live streams offer live captions?
1.2.4.notTestedReason: Live captions can only be checked during a live broadcast.

1.2.5.judge: Do recorded videos have audio description of important visual information?
1.2.5.notTestedReason: Audio description needs a person to watch the videos.

1.2.6.judge: Is sign language interpretation provided for recorded video?
1.2.6.notTestedReason: Sign language interpretation needs a person to watch the videos.

1.2.7.notTestedReason: Extended audio description needs a person to watch the videos.

1.2.8.judge: Is there a full text alternative for recorded video?
1.2.8.notTestedReason: A full text alternative needs a person to compare it with the video.

1.2.9.notTestedReason: Live audio alternatives can only be checked during a live broadcast.

1.3.1.judge: Do visual headings, lists, tables and form groups match the structure software reads?
1.3.1.notTestedReason: Structure was not compared with the visual layout on these pages.

1.3.2.judge: Does the reading order keep the meaning when read top to bottom?
1.3.2.notTestedReason: Reading order was not compared with the visual order.

1.3.3.judge: Do instructions rely only on shape, colour, size, position or sound?
1.3.3.notTestedReason: Instructions were not reviewed for references to shape, size or position.

1.3.4.notTestedReason: Portrait and landscape layouts were not compared.

1.3.5.notTestedReason: Form fields asking for personal details were not checked for their input purpose.

1.3.6.notTestedReason: Identifying the purpose of every region and icon needs a manual review.

1.4.1.judge: Is colour the only signal for links, states, errors or chart data?
1.4.1.notTestedReason: Colour-only signals need a person to look at every state.

1.4.2.notTestedReason: Pages were not checked for sound that plays automatically.

1.4.3.notTestedReason: Contrast of text over images needs a person to check.

1.4.4.notTestedReason: Text was not enlarged to 200% on these pages.

1.4.5.judge: Are there images of text that could be real text?
1.4.5.notTestedReason: Pictures of text need a person to spot them.

1.4.6.notTestedReason: Enhanced contrast was not measured in every state.

1.4.7.notTestedReason: Background sound levels need a person to listen to the recordings.

1.4.8.notTestedReason: Adjustable reading layout needs a manual review.

1.4.9.judge: Are there images of text that are not purely decorative or essential?
1.4.9.notTestedReason: Pictures of text need a person to spot them.

1.4.10.notTestedReason: The page was not checked at 320 pixels wide.

1.4.11.judge: Are control borders, icons and chart parts visible against neighbours (3:1)?
1.4.11.notTestedReason: Contrast of controls and graphics needs a person to check every state.

1.4.12.notTestedReason: Wider text spacing was not applied on these pages.

1.4.13.notTestedReason: Content that appears on hover or focus was not checked on these pages.

2.1.3.notTestedReason: Not every feature was operated with the keyboard.

2.1.4.notTestedReason: Single-key shortcuts need a manual check of every page.

2.2.2.notTestedReason: Pages were not checked for moving or auto-updating content.

2.2.6.notTestedReason: Data-loss warnings need a person to wait out inactivity.
